claim_method: distinctive_identifier_token_v3: concatenate all expected_evidence.evidence_text; markdown-unescape (backslash-escaped punctuation unescaped; strip backtick characters). From each atomic claim extract: (a) backtick-quoted spans; (b) identifiers containing '_' or a digit; (c) dotted identifiers like foo.bar; (d) CamelCase with an INTERNAL capital ([a-z][A-Z]). Skip ellipsis and abbreviations e.g./i.e./etc. Each extracted token must appear as a casefold substring in unescaped evidence. Dotted identifiers pass if the full string appears OR every component appears. Light inflection: if token missing, accept stem stripping trailing s/es/ed/ing (stem len>=4).
